declaration_purpose: Publication binding of regenerated MC campaign to source-cross-section uncertainty status per issue #1179

source_cross_section_table.source: Ermisch et al., PRC 71, 064004 (2005), Table VI, 190 MeV p-d elastic scattering

sampler_mode.description: Direct CDF inverse sampling over measured support [26.49, 169.78] deg with linear_node_pdf_exact_inverse_v1 interpolation
sampler_mode.target_distribution: p(theta) = sigma(theta) * sin(theta) / Z over measured support

statistical_uncertainty.note: Column 3 contains per-point statistical uncertainties but these were not sampled for the regenerated campaign

systematic_uncertainty.note: Source does not publish row covariance matrix. No correlation structure is available. 3% point-to-point and <4.5% total systematic bounds cannot be decomposed into defensible nuisance parameters without fabrication.

nuisance_mode.framework_reference: PR #1349 (df72735) implements cross_section_perturbation.py with fail-closed contract IDs
available_contracts: STAT_PERTURB_V1: Gaussian per-node statistical perturbation with seed
nuisance_mode.synthetic_envelope_disclaimer: The SYST_ENVELOPE_SINUSOIDAL_TAPER mode is a synthetic model (10-20% sinusoidal taper) and does NOT correspond to the source-reported 3% point-to-point or <4.5% total systematic bounds.

source_node_sensitivity.description: 3% node-box deterministic sensitivity on CDF and mean-angle observable

interpolation_sensitivity.description: Linear interpolation vs cross-section-then-Jacobian model comparison

cross_model_compatibility.description: Source-node envelope composed with alternative interpolation model

campaign_generation_parameters.note: Seeds were not centrally tracked in the regenerated campaign. Exact reproducibility requires seed recovery.

blocker_preserved.reason: Source (Ermisch et al., PRC 71, 064004, Sec. IV D) reports 3% point-to-point and <4.5% total systematic bounds but does NOT publish row covariance matrix or correlation structure. The 3% value was derived by adding error until chi^2 ≈ 1, which conflates target-thickness variation, background subtraction, and other effects. Without source-authoritative covariance, any propagated nuisance model is an assumption, not evidence.
blocker_preserved.path_to_closure: Primary-source covariance recovery would require: (1) accessing original experimental records not in the published paper; (2) re-deriving the chi^2-1 construction from raw data; or (3) source-authoritative communication from the experiment authors. The current repository cannot fabricate correlations.
blocker_preserved.gate_status: CENTRAL_VALUE_ONLY until primary covariance is obtained or an explicitly justified alternative covariance model is peer-reviewed and documented.

publication_binding.status: Central-value-only source model with systematic sensitivity framework
authorized_claims: Source differential cross-section table bytes are bound to Table VI of Ermisch et al. (2005)
Sampler mode (direct CDF inverse over measured support) is deterministic and validated
Source-node and interpolation sensitivities are quantified via PR #1190 research
No detector-level or physics claim requires propagated source systematics for this publication
prohibited_claims: No claim of source-systematic propagation in the regenerated 100k campaign
No confidence interval or p-value derived from source uncertainties without an explicit covariance model
No detector-level validation based on MC-data agreement that ignores source-model uncertainty
